business_problem: Business Capital's underwriting and sales teams could not quickly retrieve more than 15 years of deal history, merchant notes, and business intelligence scattered across Salesforce, email, and internal records; manual document review and on-premises infrastructure also slowed operations.
solution_summary: Business Capital moved its infrastructure to Google Cloud and uses managed Compute Engine and Cloud Run services, while Gemini provides natural-language access to its historical business information. Salesforce data lands continuously in BigQuery, merchant documents are retained in Cloud Storage, and employees query the unified data through tools they already use in Google Workspace. Gemini retrieves relevant statements, historical deals, and supporting details for underwriters and answers sales representatives' questions about past deal performance. The source also describes automatic extraction from bank-statement pages and existing cloud access controls, encryption, and audit records. It does not disclose a specific model version or detailed search-index design.

solution_components.name: Google Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts Business Capital's cloud infrastructure after the company moved away from on-premises hosting.

solution_components.name: Compute Engine
solution_components.role: Provides managed cloud infrastructure used to support Business Capital's platform.

solution_components.name: Cloud Run
solution_components.role: Provides managed cloud services so the technical team no longer has to maintain hardware.

solution_components.name: Salesforce
solution_components.role: Supplies deal data that is continuously loaded into BigQuery.

solution_components.name: BigQuery
solution_components.role: Stores Salesforce data as part of the unified, searchable business-data environment.

solution_components.name: Cloud Storage
solution_components.role: Retains merchant documents, including bank statements used in underwriting.

solution_components.name: Gemini
solution_components.role: Lets employees query historical data in natural language and automatically reads and extracts information from bank-statement pages.

solution_components.name: Google Workspace
solution_components.role: Provides the tools through which employees access Gemini and the unified information.

data_flow: Salesforce data lands continuously in BigQuery, while merchant documents are retained in Cloud Storage. Gemini searches and analyzes this information in response to natural-language questions in Google Workspace, surfacing historical deals and extracting bank-statement details for underwriters and sales representatives.
integration_points: Business Capital email and internal records
Merchant bank statements and other documents
business_outcome: Gemini helps Business Capital make underwriting decisions faster, increase weekly submission capacity without additional headcount, reduce manual data-search work for sales, and lower infrastructure costs.
metrics: 50% reduction in loan decision turnaround time
86% reduction in document review time per submission
45% reduction in requests to operations for historical deal searches
About two hours of search time saved per employee every week
Sales representative ramp-up time reduced from six weeks to three

Merchant documents are securely retained in Cloud Storage
Gemini processes roughly 40,000 bank-statement pages per month
Google Cloud access controls, encryption, and audit records support handling of sensitive financial information

“The system automatically reads and extracts data from roughly 40,000 bank statement pages per month, cutting document review time to just six minutes.”
